reason: The commit only relocates existing GIF statuses, constants, the std/lzw import, and application-extension byte arrays from std/gif/decode_gif.wuffs to std/gif/common_consts.wuffs. It introduces no new entry point, protocol state, configuration, input semantics, or attack surface. H0 continues to drive the GIF decoder through image configuration and repeated frame configuration/frame decoding with fuzzer-controlled input and initialization flags.
evidence: decoder_workbuf_len_max_incl_worst_case, interlace_start, interlace_delta, interlace_count, animexts1dot0, netscape2dot0, iccrgbg1012, and xmpdataxmp are removed from decode_gif.wuffs and added unchanged to common_consts.wuffs.

The statuses #bad block, #bad extension label, #bad frame size, #bad graphic control, #bad header, #bad literal width, #bad palette, and #internal error: inconsistent ri/wi are likewise relocated without behavioral changes.
The body and signature of decoder.decode_ae are unchanged in the supplied diff.
gif_fuzzer.c already invokes wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_image_config, wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame_config, and wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame on the fuzz-controlled src buffer.
recommended_action: No fuzz-harness maintenance is needed for this source-only refactoring.
